title: Klopstockstraße, Berlin
description:
Small town house or row house in the middle of Tiergarten. Own entrance, garden sharing and sun terrace in the landscape monument Interbau Hansaviertel. On the ground floor of the two-story apartment are living room and a modern fitted kitchen with all necessary electrical appliances. On the upper floor there are two private bedrooms or study rooms with bathroom and an additional workplace niche. Living, working and relaxing in the middle of a listed architectural and garden complex.

Centrally located in the Berlin district Mitte- Tiergarten. To the Kaufhaus des Westens or Bikini-Areal it is about 15, to the main station about 30 minutes walk. The nearby Tiergarten offers recreation and a variety of sports and leisure activities. Exhibition and lecture events at the Akademie der Künste on Hanseatenweg or open-air concerts at the Teahouse of the English Garden are within walking distance. Energy certificate not applicable due to monument protection.

Berlin, the dynamic capital of Germany, has firmly established itself as a city that seamlessly blends history, culture, and innovation. With its rich heritage, diverse population, and robust economy, Berlin has become a prime destination for individuals seeking a vibrant lifestyle while pursuing their educational and professional aspirations.

A Cultural Melting Pot: Berlin's allure lies in its diverse and inclusive atmosphere. It's a haven for artists, musicians, and creatives from all corners of the globe. The city's historic landmarks, such as the Brandenburg Gate and the Berlin Wall, stand as powerful reminders of its past while providing a backdrop for contemporary expression. The thriving arts scene, world-class museums, and countless galleries offer a continuous source of inspiration.

Educational Excellence: Berlin boasts an array of prestigious universities and research institutions that draw students and academics from around the world. Institutions like Humboldt University and the Technical University of Berlin provide cutting-edge research opportunities and a wide range of study programs. The city's commitment to education is further exemplified by its affordable tuition fees and numerous scholarships available to both local and international students.

Professional Opportunities: As a global economic powerhouse, Berlin offers a plethora of professional opportunities across various industries. The city's startup ecosystem is particularly noteworthy, with its reputation as the "Silicon Allee" drawing tech entrepreneurs and innovators. The low cost of living in comparison to other major European cities further enhances its appeal, allowing individuals to balance a high quality of life with exciting career prospects.

Quality of Life: Berlin consistently ranks high on quality of life indices due to its excellent infrastructure, efficient public transportation system, and well-planned urban spaces. The city's green initiatives, extensive parks, and nearby natural landscapes provide ample opportunities for outdoor activities. A diverse culinary scene, bustling markets, and a myriad of cultural events ensure there's always something to explore and enjoy.

Cultural Exchange: The international makeup of Berlin's population fosters a rich cultural exchange, allowing residents to engage with people from all walks of life. This multicultural environment not only enriches personal experiences but also creates a dynamic backdrop for professional networking and collaboration.

Work-Life Balance: Berlin's relaxed atmosphere and work-life balance set it apart from other major metropolises. The city's emphasis on leisure and recreation ensures that individuals can pursue their passions outside of their professional commitments, contributing to a well-rounded and fulfilling lifestyle.

Berlin's unique blend of history, culture, education, and economic opportunities make it an exceptional city to live, study, and work in. Whether you're captivated by its artistic scene, intrigued by its academic offerings, or seeking a thriving career, Berlin offers a multifaceted environment that fosters personal and professional growth. Embrace the Berlin experience and become a part of a city that celebrates diversity, creativity, and innovation at every turn.

title: Edwin-C.-Diltz-Straße, Berlin
description:
Take a look at this cosy room in Berlin!

The room is fully furnished, has approx. 20 m2. Bright and appealing. The flat has 116 m2, a guest toilet and a balcony. There is a bicycle cellar and a laundry cellar. There is good parking and the nearest bus stop "Clauertstr" is 2 minutes away. S-Bahn Mexikoplatz is a 12-minute walk or bus ride away. The flat is fully furnished. The kitchen has a dishwasher, washing machine, fridge-freezer, oven, cooker and microwave. Crockery, cutlery etc. is available.

Location
There are good parking possibilities and the next bus stop "Clauertstr" is 2 minutes away. In the surrounding area there is a S-Bahn stadium (Mexikoplatz) as well as the U-Bahn stadium (Krumme Lanke). Lake Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke are nearby. The Königsweg is within walking distance - here you can go for long walks or jogging.

Shared flat life
I am female and 56 years old. My two children (28 and 30) are living in other cities or have their own flats. Therefore, I have a room available that I would like to sublet for a limited period of time. Financial proof of regular income is required. Registration and private liability insurance are also required. I am also happy to sublet to Master's students, professionals, weekend home drivers or other sympathetic and rather quiet people, no party animals.

Other
The subletting contract is valid for 6 months, after that there is the possibility of an extension. Please do not bring pets. 

Please be aware that HousingAnywhere is an online booking platform. Therefore, exchanging contact details and offering viewings is not possible. If you would like to reserve this accommodation, send me a booking request or a message, and please mention your age and occupation. I look forward to meeting you!
